To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the KMS research is a relatively new area that is still developing and that the KMS literature is fragmented and has yet to develop a unifying theory.

1) the KMS field is still in a state of flux; 2) the KMS concept has not yet achieved the level of maturity necessary for a clear definition and for the development of a coherent theory of KMS; and 3) the KMS literature is characterized by the lack of a common language and by a high degree of conceptual and methodological diversity.
